settings.text: §l§bPepe's ArmorHUD §r§7(needs Pepe's Assets Pack 1.15.0+)§r
§bArmor HUD §r| §7Show the armor you wear on the HUD.§r
settings.name: pepe:ah_enabled

settings.text: §l§bPosition§r
§bScreen Edge §r| §7Which side of the screen the HUD sits on.§r
settings.name: pepe:ah_screen_side

settings.text: §fX Offset §r| §7-=Left  0=Default  +=Right§r
settings.name: pepe:ah_x

settings.text: §fY Offset §r| §7-=Down  0=Default  +=Up§r
settings.name: pepe:ah_y

settings.text: §fArmor HUD Size §r| §750=Tiny  100=Default  300=Huge §r(percent)
settings.name: pepe:ah_size

settings.text: §l§bLayout§r
§bLayout §r| §7Stack the pieces vertically or in a row.§r
settings.name: pepe:ah_layout

settings.text: §bAlignment §r| §7Where the stack sits when fewer pieces are shown (Dynamic Layout / hidden pieces).§r
settings.name: pepe:ah_align

settings.text: §bReverse Order §r| §7Boots first instead of helmet first.§r
settings.name: pepe:ah_reverse

settings.text: §bDynamic Layout §r| §7Only worn pieces take space and the stack re-centres. Off keeps every slot in place.§r
settings.name: pepe:ah_dynamic

settings.text: §fSpacing §r| §7Gap between the slots.§r
settings.name: pepe:ah_spacing

settings.text: §bEmpty Slots §r| §7Show the empty-slot icon for pieces you don't wear (all four when nothing is worn).§r
settings.name: pepe:ah_empty

settings.text: §bSmooth Slide §r| §7Pieces glide to their new spot instead of snapping.§r
settings.name: pepe:ah_slide

settings.text: §8  ↳ §r§fSlide Speed §r| §74=Slow  14=Default  30=Fast §8(needs Smooth Slide)§r
settings.name: pepe:ah_slide_speed

settings.text: §l§bPieces§r
§bHelmet §r| §7Show the helmet slot.§r
settings.name: pepe:ah_show_helmet

settings.text: §bChestplate / Elytra §r| §7Show the chestplate slot.§r
settings.name: pepe:ah_show_chest

settings.text: §bLeggings §r| §7Show the leggings slot.§r
settings.name: pepe:ah_show_legs

settings.text: §bBoots §r| §7Show the boots slot.§r
settings.name: pepe:ah_show_boots

settings.text: §l§bSlot Style§r
§bSlot Style §r| §7Hotbar Slot is the framed look, Box is a flat dark tile, None is just the icon.§r
settings.name: pepe:ah_frame

settings.text: §l§bDurability Bar§r
§bDurability Bar §r| §7Show a bar at the bottom of each slot.§r
settings.name: pepe:ah_bar

settings.text: §8  ↳ §r§bBar Color §r| §7Gradient goes green, yellow, red as the piece wears down. §8(needs Durability Bar)§r
settings.name: pepe:ah_bar_color

settings.text: §bHide When Undamaged §r| §7Hide the bar and numbers for pieces at full durability.§r
settings.name: pepe:ah_hide_full

settings.text: §l§bDurability Text§r
§bText §r| §7Percentage (85%), remaining (312) or remaining/max (312/363), same digits Glacier uses.§r
settings.name: pepe:ah_text

settings.text: §8  ↳ §r§bText Color §r| §7Durability colours the remaining number and the % from green to red; the max number stays white.§r
settings.name: pepe:ah_text_color

settings.text: §8  ↳ §r§bPosition (Vertical) §r| §7Auto = the side facing the middle of the screen.§r
settings.name: pepe:ah_text_side_v

settings.text: §8  ↳ §r§bPosition (Horizontal) §r| §7Numbers above or below each slot.§r
settings.name: pepe:ah_text_side_h

settings.text: §8  ↳ §r§fText Size §r| §750=Tiny  100=Default  200=Huge §r(percent)
settings.name: pepe:ah_text_size

settings.text: §8  ↳ §r§bText Shadow §r| §7Black shadow behind the numbers.§r
settings.name: pepe:ah_text_shadow

settings.text: §l§bWarning§r
§bLow Durability Warning §r| §7Warn when a piece is about to break.§r
settings.name: pepe:ah_warn

settings.text: §8  ↳ §r§fWarn Below §r| §7Percent durability at which the warning starts.§r
settings.name: pepe:ah_warn_pct

settings.text: §8  ↳ §r§bWarning Style §r| §7A red !! badge, a flashing red icon, or both.§r
settings.name: pepe:ah_warn_style

settings.text: §l§bElytra Pitch HUD §r§7(needs Pepe's Assets Pack)§r
§bElytra Pitch §r| §7Shows your look angle, e.g. [ 40° ], below the crosshair.§r
settings.name: pepe:elytra_pitch

settings.text: §bShow When §r| §7Choose when the HUD appears.§r
settings.name: pepe:elytra_pitch_mode

settings.text: §fElytra Pitch X §r| §7-=Left  0=Default  +=Right §r(moves the whole HUD sideways)
settings.name: pepe:elytra_pitch_x

settings.text: §fElytra Pitch Y §r| §7-=Down  0=Default  +=Up §r(raise or lower the HUD)
settings.name: pepe:elytra_pitch_y

settings.text: §fElytra Pitch Size §r| §750=Tiny  100=Default  300=Huge §r(percent)
settings.name: pepe:elytra_pitch_size

settings.text: §l§bText§r
§bBrackets §r| §7Show the [ ] around the angle.§r
settings.name: pepe:ep_brackets

settings.text: §bDegree Sign §r| §7Show the ° after the number.§r
settings.name: pepe:ep_degree

settings.text: §bMinus Sign §r| §7Show a - in front of the angle while looking up.§r
settings.name: pepe:ep_sign

settings.text: §bInvert Angle §r| §7Flip the angle: looking up becomes positive, looking down negative.§r
settings.name: pepe:ep_invert

settings.text: §bText Color §r| §7White keeps the original look. Black swaps the shadow to white so it stays readable. Indicator uses the icon's green/red. Auto turns green while climbing and red while diving.§r
settings.name: pepe:elytra_pitch_color

settings.text: §l§bIcon§r
§bElytra Icon §r| §7Show the elytra icon next to the angle.§r
settings.name: pepe:ep_icon

settings.text: §bIcon Side §r| §7Which side of the angle the icon sits on.§r
settings.name: pepe:elytra_pitch_icon_pos

settings.text: §aElytra §cIndicator §r| §7Tints the icon while an Elytra is worn: one color while gliding, another when not. Also shows the icon on its own when the angle is hidden.§r
settings.name: pepe:elytra_indicator

settings.text: §aIndicator Gliding Color §r| §7Icon color while you are gliding.§r
settings.name: pepe:elytra_ind_glide

settings.text: §cIndicator Idle Color §r| §7Icon color while you are not gliding.§r
settings.name: pepe:elytra_ind_idle

settings.text: §l§bTotem Pop Counter §r§7(needs Pepe's Assets Pack 1.9.0+)§r
§bTotem Pop Counter §r| §7Shows a totem icon and pop count above every player's nametag.§r
settings.name: pepe:tp_enabled

settings.text: §bShow On Me §r| §7Also show your own counter (visible in third person).§r
settings.name: pepe:tp_self

settings.text: §bHide At Zero §r| §7Only show a player's counter after their first pop.§r
settings.name: pepe:tp_hide_zero

settings.text: §bFlash On Pop §r| §7Turns the count red for a moment right after a pop.§r
settings.name: pepe:tp_flash

settings.text: §fMax Distance §r| §78=Very close  64=Default  128=Far §r(blocks)
settings.name: pepe:tp_dist

settings.text: §l§bPosition§r
§fCounter X §r| §7-=Left  0=Default  +=Right §r(moves the counter sideways)
settings.name: pepe:tp_x

settings.text: §fCounter Height §r| §7-=Lower  5=Default  +=Higher §r(moves the counter up or down)
settings.name: pepe:tp_height

settings.text: §fCounter Size §r| §750=Default  100=Double  250=Huge §r(percent)
settings.name: pepe:tp_size

settings.text: §l§bText§r
§bCount Color §r| §7White keeps the original look. Auto goes from green to red as a player pops more totems.§r
settings.name: pepe:tp_color

settings.text: §bBrackets §r| §7Show [ ] around the count only.§r
settings.name: pepe:tp_brackets

settings.text: §l§bIcon§r
§bTotem Icon §r| §7Show the totem icon next to the count.§r
settings.name: pepe:tp_icon

settings.text: §bIcon Side §r| §7Put the totem icon on the left or the right of the count.§r
settings.name: pepe:tp_iconside

settings.text: §l§bBackground§r
§bBackground §r| §7Draws a see-through box behind the counter so it is easier to read.§r
settings.name: pepe:tp_bg

settings.text: §bBackground Color §r| §7Color of the box behind the counter.§r
settings.name: pepe:tp_bgcolor
